verdict.rationale: The IRS's machine channels are credentialed submission rails, not a public data API. MeF is described as an XML system-to-system channel open only to Authorized e-file Providers, and IRIS A2A is gated by a Transmitter Control Code. Neither shows published public endpoints or stated API rate limits. Probes for OpenAPI or Swagger specs all returned 404, and the only published 'limit' (1 EIN per responsible party per day) applies to a web assistant, not an API.
